description: Simulation snapshot on td.scn with a train which leaves the scenery before the snapshot: an SM42 starts on the track of an isolated section and runs into a portal next to it, about 30 s in. The snapshot is taken at 90 s and has the SM42 as removed; loaded, the section has to count no axles, as in the run that went on (review of MaSzyna-EU07/maszyna#420). The run loaded from it is compared at 180 s with the run that went on.
